definitions.explanation: An honorific title used to address or refer to an emperor, empress, king, or queen. In Japan, used exclusively for the Emperor and Empress.

examples.japanese: {天皇|てんのう}{陛下|へいか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧お⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There were words from His Majesty the Emperor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧{陛下|へいか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Their Majesties visited the disaster-affected area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国賓|こくひん}→国賓：12137_kokuhin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{招|まね}かれた→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦{国王|こくおう}→国王：04152_kokuou⟧{陛下|へいか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{到着|とうちゃく}→到着：02526_touchaku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His Majesty the King, invited as a state guest, arrived at the airport.

notes:
The highest honorific title for a monarch. In Japan, applies only to the ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧ (Emperor) and ⟦{皇后|こうごう}→皇后：16354_kougou⟧ (Empress).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天皇|てんのう}{陛下|へいか} (His Majesty the Emperor)
- ⟦{皇后|こうごう}→皇后：16354_kougou⟧{陛下|へいか} (Her Majesty the Empress)
- ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧{陛下|へいか} (Their Majesties — the Emperor and Empress together)
- ⟦{国王|こくおう}→国王：04152_kokuou⟧{陛下|へいか} (His Majesty the King)
- ⟦{女王|じょおう}→女王：03349_joou⟧{陛下|へいか} (Her Majesty the Queen)

The word {陛|へい} originally referred to the steps leading up to the throne. Addressing the emperor through the steps (rather than directly) was considered properly respectful.

Do not confuse with {殿下|でんか} (His/Her Royal Highness), used for princes, princesses, and other members of the imperial family below the emperor.
